items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I didn't want to work with Cab. He had a lot of good men with him but I always felt ... that he didn't give the guys a chance to actually do what they could do.

ctx.x: notes. And he was with Lunceford when he got popular in New York at the Cotton Club, Thommy was, and nice looking boy. He was a fantastic trumpet player.

And we used to play a lot of battle of the bands and music with this band. They'd come to Washington. We'd go to Baltimore. And they had some good -- they had a couple of brothers, Chauncey Horton who later played with Cab Calloway. He was on that band. And Shorty Horton, his brother played -- one played the saxophone and one played trombone. And they were very good players on that band.
